messages:
owen_research: dropped a compact-grid mock for the vectors preview. goal is denser rows for power users: 8 vectors per row, minimal meta, inline relevance chip and a tiny "show details" chevron. figma: https://figma.redwood/example/compact-grid

leah_a11y: nice. accessibility reminders: treat the list as a grid/table (role=\"grid\") so screen readers can navigate columns; provide a visible label and ensure each row has a logical focus target. also add sr-only text for the chevron: 'Expand row details'.

alex_frontend: agree on role=\"grid\". implementation notes: use a11y-friendly table semantics rather than divs for keyboard/AT compatibility. sample: `<div role=\"grid\" aria-label=\"Vectors preview\">` and rows with `role=\"row\"` and cells `role=\"gridcell\"` — keep it simple for virtualized lists.

mika_design: visual/ux asks: 1) make the relevance chip dual-coded (color + subtle icon) for colorblind folks, 2) add a compact header that becomes sticky when you start multi-selecting rows so export actions are always visible.

ben_prod: product question: when user hits Export, do we stream a download for small sets and background for large? we need clear copy for each case. maybe: small <= 500 rows -> immediate download; >500 -> background job with ETA and notification. include an opt-out checkbox: 'Always run large exports in background'.

lighthouse_bot: accessibility-scan: found issues on current mock: no aria-live on export status, chevron lacks sr-only label, relevance orange contrast 3.1:1 (needs >=4.5:1 for body text), keyboard focus styles missing on row action buttons.

alex_frontend: export modal sketch: header 'Download vectors (CSV)'; body shows estimated rows x cols and approx size (KB/MB). actions: primary 'Download now' (disabled if >500 and user hasn't opted in), secondary 'Run in background'. focus trap + restore focus to the export button after close. add `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` for job queued message.

mika_design: copy tweak: instead of 'Export' use 'Download' for immediate flows and 'Queue download' when backgrounded. microcopy for modal body: 'Includes id, snippet, vector_norm, source, and metadata fields you selected.'

owen_research: small ux: show vector_norm (length) as a discreet numeric column so researchers can quickly filter by magnitude. also add a tiny sparkline to show relevance trend after rerank ops.

leah_a11y: for the sparkline provide an accessible text alternative like 'Relevance trend: up 12% over last rerank' and ensure it is not the only indicator of change.

alex_frontend: touch/mobile note: hover menus don't work. implement long-press to show the row menu on mobile and a persistent kebab on focus for keyboard. keep hit targets >=44px. also support keyboard shortcuts: Shift+click for range select, Space to toggle selection on focused row, and 'A' for select-all when grid has focus.

ben_prod: metrics + UX: show an inline count pill when selecting (e.g., '12 selected') and a compact action bar: Download | Add to set | Clear. that action bar should be dismissible via Esc.

lighthouse_bot: accessibility-scan-2 queued: will re-run after updates. failing rules to watch: color-contrast, aria-live presence, focus order.

mika_design: another tiny nit: pinned rows show a blue chip currently but no `aria-pressed` state. change to a toggle button with `aria-pressed` and a tooltip 'Pinned: keeps this vector at top of view'.

owen_research: rerank action feedback: when someone clicks 'Mark relevant' we should show an ephemeral inline toast 'Reranked 1 item' and update the sparkline. ensure to announce 'Reranked 1 item' to screen readers using an aria-live region.

alex_frontend: performance note: virtualization is mandatory for >200 rows. expanding a row should reuse a single details node to avoid DOM churn (re-parent content into the open panel). avoid animating height on many rows.

leah_a11y: final checklist before dev: grid semantics, chevron sr-label, aria-expanded on rows, aria-live polite for downloads/reranks, focus restore from modal, buttons with visible focus ring, color + icon redundancy on relevance.

mika_design: i'll update the figma to include: sticky selection bar, compact header, color+icon relevance, vector_norm column, and revised button labels. new mock: https://figma.redwood/example/compact-grid-v2 please add :eyes: if you want keyboard testing in sprint 41.

ben_prod: thanks! i'll scope export size estimates and background worker behavior in the ticket.

alex_frontend: i'll prototype keyboard nav and long-press menu in the feature branch. will ping for early accessibility QA.
